name: UnitOfMeasure
description: A unit in which goods are counted, weighed or sold, from UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: UN/CEFACT common code, such as EA, KGM or CS; the natural key.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name, such as each, kilogram or case.

attributes.name: dimension
attributes.description: What the unit measures - count, mass, length, volume or area.

attributes.name: isBaseUnit
attributes.description: Whether the unit is the base of its dimension.

attributes.name: decimalsAllowed
attributes.description: Decimals allowed on quantities in the unit.
